exposure: Transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block with 0.25% ropivacaine
TAP block with 0.25% ropivacaine and dexmedetomidine
TAP block with 0.25% ropivacaine and clonidine
cohort: The study included patients admitted to JLNMCH Bhagalpur undergoing elective and emergency lower segment cesarean section without maternal and fetal compromise.
finding: The addition of dexmedetomidine to ropivacaine in TAP block significantly enhanced block quality and duration of analgesia, and reduced overall analgesic consumption in 24 hours compared to plain ropivacaine or clonidine addition.
